description: This file defines the ProductRepository class responsible for fetching and managing product data from a network API in a Kotlin frontend application. It includes methods for retrieving paginated product results with filters and search queries, as well as a data class for representing page results and a mapping function from DTO to domain model.

classes.name: ProductRepository
classes.description: Main class responsible for fetching product data via network API with pagination, search, and filters.

classes.name: PageResult
classes.description: Data class representing a page of products with total count.

methods.name: fetchProductsPage
methods.description: Retrieves a page of products from the API with optional search query and filters, processes the response to map DTOs to domain objects, and returns a PageResult.
